title: S&P DJI March quarterly rebalance takes effect at the open — S&P 500/100/400/600 membership, share and float changes implemented at the 2027-03-19 close
source: EST: the index owner's own effective-date wording, applied forward to a quarter this calendar does not yet carry. The wording was established across four December instances by the sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-12-21 lane, each fetched direct from S&P Dow Jones Indices' own newsroom and each reading verbatim "effective prior to the open of trading on" the Monday following the quarter's third Friday: 2022-12-19 (third Friday 2022-12-16), 2023-12-18 (2023-12-15), 2024-12-23 (2024-12-20), 2025-12-22 (2025-12-19). The third Friday of March 2027 is 2027-03-19 — quad-witching, already tracked as opex-2027-03-19 — so the rebalance implements at that close and is effective prior to the open of Monday 2027-03-22. This calendar already carries sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-09-21, sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-12-21 and sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-12-20 on the identical convention, so this is a gap in an existing series rather than a rule extrapolated into a quarter nobody tracks. Filed estimate because it is derived from the owner's standing wording rather than from a published 2027 date, and because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Proposed by russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-03-31 initial research, 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED by the proposer's adjacency sweep and filed as a GAP, not as calendar filler — the December sibling in the capping family declined the whole 2027 month-end class on the grounds that "extrapolating a standing rule twelve months out is calendar noise, not foresight", and that reasoning is accepted here. The difference: the S&P quarterly rebalance effective date is a series this calendar already tracks for three other quarters, and its March 2027 reference close is ALREADY tracked as sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-03-12 — so the calendar currently carries the input to this event without carrying the event, which is the shape of a hole rather than of an extrapolation. It sits inside the proposer's own 2027-03-10 → 2027-03-25 drift window and shares 2027-03-22 with the proposed russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2027-03-22, making that session a double index-flow open. It changes no number in the proposer's ledger, which is why it is filed as a proposal and flagged for its own family's lane rather than argued in this one. Impact low and symbols empty on the same basis as every other index-flow entry here.
